name: Thunder Nova · Death · Fire
primary:
An explosion at the aim point with a 6.52-block radius (does not hit you):
• Damage 4.5 ❤ lightning + 2.25 ❤ arcane + 2 ❤ fire (lightning ×2 on wet, fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Charge 126: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 12 targets in a row, jumps up to 7 blocks, 4.5 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 6.75 s
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 6 s
• Life drain: 1 ❤ damage, you heal 0.52 ❤
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:
An explosion around you with a 6.52-block radius, hitting you as well:
• Damage 4.5 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 126: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 6.75 s
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 4.5 s
• Heat: sets on fire for 4.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
